build.beforeDevCommand: cargo build --release -p beacond && mkdir -p ../../target/sidecar && cp ../../target/release/beacond "../../target/sidecar/beacond-$(rustc -vV | awk '/^host:/ {print $2}')" && npm run dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: cargo build --release -p beacond && mkdir -p ../../target/sidecar && cp ../../target/release/beacond "../../target/sidecar/beacond-$(rustc -vV | awk '/^host:/ {print $2}')" && npm run build
